description: This Java class 'PlatformCache' represents an entity for cache configuration within the Fineract system. It extends a custom persistable class and defines cache type properties, along with methods to check the cache type.

classes.name: PlatformCache
classes.description: Entity class representing cache configurations in the system, extending a custom persistable base class.

methods.name: isNoCachedEnabled
methods.description: Checks if 'no cache' is enabled based on the cache type.

methods.name: isEhcacheEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Ehcache is enabled based on the cache type.

methods.name: isDistributedCacheEnabled
methods.description: Checks if distributed cache is enabled based on the cache type.
